result:
The count is **1000**.

**Setup.** Group rows into {1}, {2,3}, …, {18,19} and columns the same way. This gives a 10×10 array of blocks, and each block contains at most one selected cell (cells in a block are pairwise adjacent). Since 99 cells are selected and there are 100 blocks, exactly one block (the "hole") is empty and every other block holds exactly one cell.

**Block coordinates.** Write a cell in block (I,J) as (2I+a, 2J+b) with a, b ∈ {0,1}. Row 0 and column 0 do not exist, so a = 1 in block row 0 and b = 1 in block column 0. Two cells in neighbouring blocks conflict only in these cases:
- Horizontal neighbours: b_left = 1 and b_right = 0.
- Vertical neighbours: a_upper = 1 and a_lower = 0.
- Diagonal neighbours: a set of forbidden offset pairs, which can only occur next to the hole.

**Forcing.** Suppose the hole is at (p,q).
- Every column J ≠ q is full, so its a-values start at 1 and must stay 1: all a = 1 there.
- Every row I ≠ p is full, so its b-values start at 1 and must stay 1: all b = 1 there.
- Column q below the hole: a-values are 0…0 then 1…1 going down. Let s be the number of leading zeros, s ∈ {0, …, 9−p}. That gives 10−p choices.
- Row p to the right of the hole: b-values are 0…0 then 1…1 going right. Let t be the number of leading zeros, t ∈ {0, …, 9−q}. That gives 10−q choices.

**Remaining conflict.** The only forbidden diagonal pair is the cell in block (p,q+1) with (a,b) = (1,0) together with the cell in block (p+1,q) with (a,b) = (0,1). This occurs exactly when s ≥ 1 and t ≥ 1, which gives (9−p)(9−q) invalid combinations.

So the number of configurations with hole at (p,q) is

N(p,q) = (10−p)(10−q) − (9−p)(9−q).

**Summing over all holes.**

Σ_{p,q} (10−p)(10−q) = 55² = 3025, and Σ_{p,q} (9−p)(9−q) = 45² = 2025.

Total = 3025 − 2025 = 1000.

**Check.** The same argument for an m×m block array (side 2m−1) gives m³. For the 3×3 board this gives 8, which matches a direct enumeration of the size-3 independent sets (4 corner triples plus 4 mixed sets). For m = 10 it gives 10³ = 1000.

ANSWER: 1000
